criteria_coverage.criterion: A teacher can register by providing name, email, and password, and a new account is created for them.
criteria_coverage.notes: The registration flow test now shares the action's repository via vi.mock('@/auth') and the testRepo getter, so persistence assertions observe the same instance used by registerAction.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Registration rejects an email that is already associated with an existing account, and the teacher is told the email is already in use.
criteria_coverage.notes: The registration duplicate-email test now seeds the shared repository instance and asserts AUTH_ERRORS.EMAIL_IN_USE.

criteria_coverage.criterion: A teacher's password is never retained in a readable form; it is stored only in a securely hashed form.
criteria_coverage.notes: The suite verifies bcrypt hashing behavior and now checks the stored registration value on the action's actual repository instance.

criteria_coverage.criterion: A registered teacher can sign in with the correct email and password and becomes a recognized, signed-in user.
tests: src/auth.__tests__/credentials.test.ts :: returns user object (no passwordHash) for correct credentials
src/app/(auth)/sign-in/__tests__/page.test.ts :: Sign-in success flow — components verify correctly
criteria_coverage.notes: The credentials test now exercises the real normalizeEmail → userRepository.findByEmail → verifyPassword chain and asserts the returned user shape excludes passwordHash.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Signing in with an unknown email or an incorrect password is rejected with a user-friendly invalid-credentials message that does not reveal which part was wrong.
tests: src/auth.__tests__/credentials.test.ts :: returns null for wrong password / unknown email / enumeration resistance
criteria_coverage.notes: The credentials suite now proves both failure paths return the same null outcome and anchors AUTH_ERRORS.INVALID_CREDENTIALS to the locked string literal.

criteria_coverage.criterion: A signed-in teacher remains recognized across subsequent page views/requests within the same session.
criteria_coverage.notes: Accepted as manual/e2e-only per dispatch note.

criteria_coverage.criterion: A teacher can sign out, and after signing out they are treated as unauthenticated.
criteria_coverage.notes: Accepted as manual/e2e-only per dispatch note.

criteria_coverage.criterion: After sign-out, the previously issued session can no longer be used to access protected areas.
criteria_coverage.notes: Accepted as manual/e2e-only per dispatch note.

criteria_coverage.criterion: A request from an unauthenticated visitor to a protected route or protected API endpoint is rejected (not served the protected content).
tests: src/middleware.__tests__/middleware.test.ts :: Middleware blocks unauthenticated request to protected route
src/middleware.__tests__/middleware.test.ts :: Middleware matcher pattern excludes public paths
criteria_coverage.notes: The known next-auth ESM import issue is an env_bug and not treated as a spec/design blocker.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Authentication-related errors (invalid credentials, duplicate email, missing/invalid fields) are surfaced as friendly, understandable messages.
criteria_coverage.notes: Friendly duplicate-email and validation paths are covered, and the invalid-credentials message constant is now locked to the expected literal.

criteria_coverage.criterion: Submitting registration or sign-in with missing or malformed fields is rejected with a clear validation message.
tests: src/app/(auth)/sign-in/__tests__/page.test.ts :: sign-in validation — empty email / empty password / invalid email format
criteria_coverage.notes: The missing sign-in validation coverage has been added for empty email, empty password, and malformed email format.

test_findings.summary: One older constant-self-comparison remains redundant but is no longer coverage-critical.
test_findings.details: The page-level sign-in suite still contains a lightweight AUTH_ERRORS.INVALID_CREDENTIALS self-comparison, but the blocking tautology concern is resolved because src/auth.__tests__/credentials.test.ts now anchors the constant to the locked string literal and covers the shared failure outcome.

one_line_summary: All four prior blockers are resolved; the revised test suite is sufficient for approval, with AC6/AC7/AC8 remaining intentionally manual/e2e-only.
